diagram:
flowchart TD
  SCHED["⏰ Weekdays 4:15PM"] --> FETCH["📋 Fetch Open Positions"]
  FETCH --> PRICES["💲 Batch Fetch Prices"]
  PRICES --> LLM_EXIT{"exit_reason=llm_exit?"}
  LLM_EXIT -->|Yes| FORCE_CLOSE["🔒 Force Close"]
  LLM_EXIT -->|No| UPDATE_HIGH["📈 Update highest_price"]
  UPDATE_HIGH --> TRAIL["📐 Compute trailing_stop\nmax(stop, high×0.93)"]
  TRAIL --> CHECK{"Stop or Target hit?"}
  CHECK -->|Yes| CLOSE["🔒 Close + Record"]
  CHECK -->|No| UPDATE_STOP["💾 Update stop_loss"]
  CLOSE --> CASH["💰 Return Cash to Portfolio"]

SCHED.label: Weekdays 4:15PM
SCHED.description: After market close via Claude Code scheduled task. After-hours prices are final for the day.
SCHED.addReason: Daily price check without LLM cost. Market close is right time — intraday swings don't trigger stops.

FETCH.label: Fetch Open Positions
FETCH.description: Fetches all paper_positions where closed_at IS NULL.
FETCH.addReason: Need all open positions to check each one.

PRICES.label: Batch Fetch Prices
PRICES.description: Fetches prev-day close prices for all open symbols via Polygon API. Parallel requests.
PRICES.addReason: Need current price to compare against stop_loss and price_target.

LLM_EXIT.label: LLM Exit Flag Check
LLM_EXIT.description: LearnerAgent may have flagged exit_reason='llm_exit' if thesis broke. Closes immediately.
LLM_EXIT.addReason: LearnerAgent flags; position monitor executes. Clean separation.

FORCE_CLOSE.label: Force Close
FORCE_CLOSE.description: Closes llm_exit positions at current price regardless of stop/target levels.
FORCE_CLOSE.addReason: Thesis broken — exit regardless of price.

UPDATE_HIGH.label: Update highest_price
UPDATE_HIGH.description: highest_price = max(current highest_price, current price). Ratchets up, never down.
UPDATE_HIGH.addReason: Trailing stop anchors to all-time high since entry.

TRAIL.label: Compute trailing_stop
TRAIL.description: trailing_stop = max(original stop_loss, highest_price × 0.93). 7% below peak.
TRAIL.addReason: Trailing stop locks in gains. Once stock +20%, stop trails up to guarantee minimum profit.

CHECK.label: Stop/Target Check
CHECK.description: price <= trailing_stop → close LOSS (or profit if trailed). price >= price_target → close WIN.

CLOSE.label: Close + Record
CLOSE.description: Sets closed_at, exit_price, realized_pnl, pnl_pct, outcome, exit_reason on paper_positions.
CLOSE.addReason: Full close record for LearnerAgent analysis.

UPDATE_STOP.label: Update stop_loss
UPDATE_STOP.description: Writes new trailing_stop to paper_positions.stop_loss. Used on next run.

CASH.label: Return Cash to Portfolio
CASH.description: Adds exit_price × qty to paper_portfolio.cash_balance. Updates open_positions count.
CASH.addReason: Closed positions release capital for new trades.
